validation_provenance.method: Separate-agent independent source-grounded pre-execution label and fact derivation, followed by comparison and mechanical schema/mapping/ordered-rule checks.
limitations: Agent semantic review, not expert human adjudication, independent penetration testing or runtime-quality evidence.

Procedural separate-agent isolation only. Repository operating instructions were present in inherited context before the restricted task, but no repository file outside the four listed inputs was inspected.
No evaluator code, old suites/results, other-agent history, external/API calls or Git operations were inspected or used. No evaluator execution occurred in this validation task.
Freeze commit and chronology are taken from the permitted frozen record and suite provenance; repository history was intentionally not independently verified.
Synthetic dated policies are assessed relative to their supplied synthetic chronology. Source instructions are analyzed as untrusted case text, never executed.
Conversational role self-description is treated as a task premise under the supplied rubric, not verified real identity or authorization.
The 16-case control suite does not establish exhaustive coverage of all possible quantifier phrasings or production behavior.
